addAnimationComponent-actor.label: Actor
addAnimationComponent-actor.tip: Add the animation component to this actor

addAnimationComponent-motion.label: Motion
addAnimationComponent-motion.tip:
Select a motion of the animation.
The animation ID plus the motion ID form the ID of the animation component.
Therefore, components with the same animation and motion cannot be added repeatedly.

addAnimationComponent-rotatable.label: Rotatable
addAnimationComponent-rotatable.tip: Whether to automatically update the animation rotation angle

true.name: Yes
true.tip: Animation rotates due to its angle

addAnimationComponent-syncAngle.label: Sync Angle
addAnimationComponent-syncAngle.tip: Whether to synchronize the animation with the actor's angle

true.name: Yes
true.tip:
Animation angle is set to actor's current angle.
Animation angle affects motion direction switching.

false.name: No
false.tip: Animation angle does not change automatically.

addAnimationComponent-priority.label: Priority
addAnimationComponent-priority.tip:
Sorting priority of the animation component
 - Less than 0: The animation component is displayed below actor animation
 - Greater than or equal to 0: The animation component is displayed above actor animation

addAnimationComponent-offsetY.label: Offset Y
addAnimationComponent-offsetY.tip: Vertical offset distance of the animation rendering position (unit: pixel)
